verdict.rationale: Docs confirm API-driven stablecoin sending to blockchain addresses (bvnk-docs-13, bvnk-docs-14, bvnk-docs-18), wallet creation for customers via API (bvnk-docs-4, bvnk-docs-25), and webhook-based status notifications (bvnk-docs-2, bvnk-docs-21) which together cover payout initiation and event tracking. However, there is no dedicated documentation of a 'stored recipient' payout object or a clear end-to-end status/settlement lifecycle specific to stablecoin payouts (only fiat payout overview details reconciliation/bank-account flows). Missing for 10: explicit stored-recipient/payee management API, detailed stablecoin payout status states through to on-chain settlement confirmation, and independent/hands-on verification of the payout flow.
